arc: hook (three-line kinetic statement) → announcement (now live in your checkout, 3D tile orbit) → transition (tile column "wherever India shops") → reveal (Introducing the pay badge on GenMotion) → workflow (phone: product → bag → payment options → one tap) → feature (checkout in one tap / verified on your device + fingerprint) → feature (confirming coin → payment successful receipt) → announcement (now on GenMotion Checkout) → benefit (fast / safe / simple) → cta + partner lockup

scenes.title: Three-beat kinetic headline over slate smoke
scenes.summary: On near-black, a soft slate smoke plume rises in over 15 frames. "The" lands oversized and centred, shrinks as "tap" slides in beside it; hard cut to "your customers" settling from 1.06x; hard cut to "already know by heart", whose words sweep left-to-right from off-white to violet (#9b9cff) as the line lands and drifts slowly. Everything cuts to black at the end.
scenes.build: Background is a full-screen clip-space shader (components/stage.ts smoke): a tilted gaussian beam with an S-curve spine, low-octave fbm warp and dark pockets, driven by uTime and uIntensity. Lines are words()/text() canvas-texture planes from components/text.ts; each word's material.color is lerped for the accent sweep, beats are toggled by frame windows with interpolate().
scenes.reuse: Reusable cold open for any "the X your customers already Y" statement: swap the three lines, the accent colour and the beat frame windows. The smoke shader is generic atmosphere for dark premium openers. Nothing brand-specific here.

scenes.title: 3D commerce tiles rush in from behind the camera into a ring around the headline
scenes.summary: Sixteen bevelled 3D tiles (light, navy and dark skins) with commerce glyphs — shield, check, cart, rupee, shirt, chart, plane, globe, bag, coins, card, phone — fly in from scattered positions in front of the lens, de-spinning into a slowly turning elliptical ring that bobs gently. "Now live in your checkout" rises in word by word at the centre, with "your checkout" in violet. The camera then pushes forward through the ring as the headline fades.
scenes.build: Tiles come from components/tiles.ts tile(): an ExtrudeGeometry rounded slab with bevels plus a canvas-drawn glyph face, lit by tileLights(). Each tile has a seeded (mulberry32) start position, spin and ring angle; per frame it lerps start→ring target and slerps spin→tilt quaternions, with the ring angle advancing linearly. The camera z push is an easeIn interpolate over the last 26 frames.
scenes.reuse: Strong template for "works with / now live in" or ecosystem beats: swap the glyphs (or the tile faces for partner logos), the headline words and accent. Keep the seeded PRNG so it stays deterministic. The rupee glyph and India-commerce icon set are market-specific.

scenes.title: Macro column of 3D tiles racing up past a caption
scenes.summary: A vertical column of ten big 3D tiles (arrow, check, globe, chart, shirt, shield, cart, coins, card, bag) races upward past the lens, parting around the caption and slipping back in depth as they cross it, then decelerates and lands on a held frame with the cart tile above and coins below. The caption "wherever India shops" fades in word by word with "India" in violet, and breathes slightly once the column lands. About one second long.
scenes.build: Same tile() slabs as scene 02. A single quartic-ease scroll value drives every tile's y; a smooth monotonic offset y0 + 1.1*y0/sqrt(y0²+0.9) parts tiles around the caption line without a jump, and a gaussian on y0 shrinks and pushes back tiles near it. Camera z eases 7.2→6.6 with the landing.
scenes.reuse: Use as a fast energetic bridge between a headline and a reveal, or for a "wherever your customers are" line. Swap caption and glyph list; the parting formula is the reusable trick. Short — works best kept at ~1 s.

scenes.title: "Introducing" → partner badge on GenMotion → badge rushes the lens into white
scenes.summary: On black with a soft diagonal light shaft and radial glow, a small "Introducing" fades in and out. Then a white rounded badge with the black Samsung Pay lockup scales up, with a muted "on" and the GenMotion lockup (lime→teal gradient mark + wordmark) rising in below. The caption fades and the camera rushes into the badge while the backdrop mixes to white.
scenes.build: components/stage.ts backdrop() is a clip-space shader with uniforms for a drifting diagonal shaft, bottom glow, centre radial, uWhite mix and a bottom-up uWipe. The badge and lockups are canvas-drawn planes from components/marks.ts (payBadge, genmotionLockup) using SVG path data in components/brand.ts. The rush is a camera position/lookAt interpolate toward the badge.
scenes.reuse: Classic "Introducing X on Y" partnership reveal: swap the badge art and partner lockup for your own marks. The camera-rush-into-white handoff is a clean transition into a white scene. Don't reuse the Samsung Pay or GenMotion paths for another brand.

scenes.title: Phone rises through the headline and taps product → bag → pay button
scenes.summary: On white, "Built for every storefront" (navy→royal gradient on "storefront") then "and every screen" part to let a 3D phone rise from below into centre. The camera tracks down the screen as a touch dot taps "Add to bag" on a ceramic-lamp product page (LUMA, ₹4,800), then "Continue" on the bag, then scrolls Payment options and taps the black Samsung Pay button under "Recommended". The phone slides right as "One tap" appears beside it, the pay sheet opens, and the scene darkens to black with a violet floor glow.
scenes.build: components/phone.ts makePhone() builds an extruded metallic body, bezel, screen plane, camera island and side button; show(tex, scrollPx) swaps canvas-drawn screen textures (screenProduct, screenCheckout, screenPaymentOptions, screenPaySheet) and scrolls via texture offset; touchAt() places a press dot in screen px. Camera target y/z are keyframed with interpolate() to zoom onto each tap.
scenes.reuse: The go-to reference for an app checkout / onboarding demo inside a 3D phone: replace the screen canvases with your app's screens and edit the taps array [frame, x, y]. The touch dot + camera dolly onto each tap reads clearly. Product (LUMA lamp, ₹ prices) and Samsung Pay button art are template content.

scenes.title: Parked phone with pay sheet, side-button pulse and fingerprint check
scenes.summary: On black with a violet floor glow, the camera pulls back from the pay sheet (Pay LUMA, ₹4,800, card •••• 4821, Touch to pay) and parks the phone on the right with a slight turn. Left-aligned two-line headlines slide in word by word: "Checkout / in one tap" then "Verified / on your device" (second line violet). A white ring pulses twice at the side button, the camera island grows into a square showing a violet fingerprint, which turns into a green check-in-circle.
scenes.build: Reuses makePhone() and screenPaySheet() from components/phone.ts. The first 26 frames interpolate from scene 05's final camera framing to the parked pose (a matched handoff). Headlines are words() groups anchored to the camera's left edge; the pulse is a RingGeometry scaled/faded; the fingerprint is a plane whose material swaps between two canvas textures at frame 132.
scenes.reuse: Use for a security / biometric / verification beat: phone on one side, two-line claim on the other, a single on-device confirmation moment. Swap headlines and the confirmation glyph. If used alone, drop the opening settle from 05's camera pose.

scenes.title: Spinning 3D gold coin → green "Payment successful" receipt with rays
scenes.summary: Close on the phone: "Confirming payment / This takes a few seconds" with a 3D gold ₹ coin spinning above the screen while a blue swoosh ribbon grows into it. The coin shrinks away and a green check badge pops (0.4→1.08→1), the text flips to "Payment successful", then the check jumps to the top of an all-green screen with a white receipt card (LUMA, ₹4,800 paid, via Samsung Pay) and eight light rays burst around it. The backdrop glow shifts violet→green and the phone lifts out of frame.
scenes.build: The coin is a CylinderGeometry with a canvas-drawn radial-gold face (₹ glyph) on both caps and a metallic edge material, parented to the phone and spun by time. Swoosh and check are canvas-texture planes; rays are 8 small planes around the check. Screens swap at frames 59/67 via phone.show(); backdrop uGlowColor lerps to green.
scenes.reuse: Payoff beat for any payment, transfer or order flow: processing state with a 3D token, then a success screen with a check burst. Swap the currency glyph, receipt copy and success colour. Merchant name and Samsung Pay line are template copy.

scenes.title: Badge · "now on" · GenMotion Checkout, then a white wipe
scenes.summary: On black with a drifting light shaft, the white Samsung Pay badge, a muted "now on", and the GenMotion Checkout lockup stagger in from top to bottom and float slightly. A white wipe rises from the bottom over the last 8 frames. Under two seconds.
scenes.build: Three canvas planes from components/marks.ts (payBadge, genmotionLockup with a "Checkout" suffix) faded in with a 3-frame stagger; backdrop() uWipe drives the bottom-up white reveal.
scenes.reuse: A near-duplicate of scene 04's badge + lockup beat, shorter and without the camera rush; borrow the uWipe bottom-up white transition rather than the layout.

scenes.title: "fast" → "safe" → "simple" built letter by letter on white
scenes.summary: On white, three huge (180 px) lowercase words in an ink→royal-blue gradient appear one after another, each letter rising in two frames after the last and the word slowly scaling up: "fast", "safe", then "simple", which fades out just before the cut.
scenes.build: components/text.ts letters() splits each word into per-letter planes and samples the gradient per letter by x so the word reads as one ramp; each letter's opacity and y are interpolated from a staggered start frame.
scenes.reuse: Simple, reusable three-adjective benefit beat — swap the words, colours and timing. Pairs well after a demo and before the CTA.

scenes.title: Two-line CTA inks in, then a partner lockup holds and hard-cuts to black
scenes.summary: On white, "Bring one-tap pay / to your checkout today" rises in word by word in light grey, each word darkening to ink a few frames later. The CTA fades and a centred lockup — GenMotion mark + wordmark | a thin divider | the Samsung Pay logo — fades in, slowly scales, holds, and hard-cuts to black in the last 5 frames.
scenes.build: Two stacked copies of each line from words(): a grey layer and an ink layer with an offset stagger, giving the "inked a beat later" effect. Lockup is genmotionLockup() + a divider plane + samsungPayMark() from components/marks.ts; the cut flips backdrop uWhite to 0.
scenes.reuse: Standard end card for a partnership or integration launch: swap CTA lines and the two marks. The grey-then-ink word reveal is a nice, cheap trick for any CTA. Don't reuse the partner logos.
